stories.title: Create users table in Supabase
stories.acceptance_criteria: users table exists with columns: id (UUID PK), username (TEXT UNIQUE), password_hash (TEXT), role (TEXT with CHECK), display_name (TEXT), active (BOOLEAN), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ). DDL added to init.py and executes without error.

stories.title: Password hashing utility with bcrypt
stories.acceptance_criteria: tythe_time_tracker/core/auth.py exists with hash_password() and verify_password() functions. bcrypt added to requirements.txt. Functions correctly hash and verify passwords.

stories.title: Login page
stories.acceptance_criteria: Login form with username and password fields renders as app landing page. On valid credentials, st.session_state.current_user is set with id, username, role, display_name. Invalid credentials show error message.

stories.title: Protect all routes behind authentication
stories.acceptance_criteria: All pages check st.session_state.current_user; unauthenticated users see login page. Manager dashboard additionally checks role=='manager'. Logout button in sidebar clears session.

stories.title: Seed first manager on DB init
stories.acceptance_criteria: When users table is empty and SEED_MANAGER_USERNAME + SEED_MANAGER_PASSWORD env vars are set, a manager account is created automatically during init. Skipped if vars are missing or table is non-empty.

stories.title: Manager creates employee and manager accounts
stories.acceptance_criteria: Manager dashboard has a 'Manage Users' tab with: create user form (username, password, display_name, role), list of all users with active/deactivate toggle. Only managers can access.

stories.title: Wire employee identity to authenticated session
stories.acceptance_criteria: Clock in/out uses current_user display_name from session (no free-text name input). Personal timesheet auto-filters to logged-in user's name. Employee interface no longer has a name text input.
